name: smwmusic-touhou-fuujinroku-mountain-of-faith-kanako-s-fierce-ambition-cemetery-of-onbashira-grave-of-being-remix
title: Touhou Fuujinroku ~ Mountain of Faith - Kanako's Fierce Ambition ~ Cemetery of Onbashira ~ Grave of Being (Remix)
description:
𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐦𝐞 𝐘𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐤𝐚 𝐜𝐮𝐬 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐬𝐞𝐞 𝐦𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐬𝐚𝐲 𝐘𝐀𝐀𝐀𝐒𝐒𝐒𝐒

Did an arrangement of big ol' mama :p Kanako Yasaka's stage theme, Cemetery of Onbashira ~ Grave of Being from Touhou 10: Mountain of Faith. Man, I can't believe it's been a while since I actually did a Touhou arrangement.

Big fan of Kanako and have been wanting to do her stage theme for some time now. It slaps. It freaking slaps. It slaps so hard, more people come to the Moriya Shrine to give Kanako their faith just 'cuz of this fire music!!! I'm sure half of you get the joke... hopefully.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. F# Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. F Minor (Custom Pitch)
